original_question:
Write a Verilog module named `adder`.
The module should perform 8-bit signed addition.
It takes two 8-bit signed inputs: `A` and `B`.
It should output the 8-bit signed result of the addition as `sum`.
It should also output a single bit `C` which represents the carry (or overflow into the 9th bit position) resulting from the 8-bit signed addition.
The interface should be defined as:
inputs: `input signed [7:0] A`, `input signed [7:0] B`
outputs: `output signed [7:0] sum`, `output reg C`
